legend: Figure 1. Breast cancer single-cell atlas used in the reconstruction. The authors generated this figure in their phase-1 workflow from public GSE176078 count matrices and carried it forward unchanged into v3; no panel reproduces or adapts Wu et al. A, workflow-derived embedding colored by major cell type. B, molecular-subtype labels. C, workflow-derived inferred malignancy classification. D, cell-type fractions by atlas sample/patient label. The analyzed object contains 94,607 cells and 26 labels; labels are not treated as 26 independent patients.

Figure 2. Clean network accounting and topology. A, legacy retained typed group records, partitioned into self-pairs removed and distinct-gene records. B, clean physical edges, with SL/SV annotations collapsed within group. C, estimable topS from 1,000 fixed-topology weight permutations; points are nodes, not independent patients. D, retained typed records carrying indirect functional-evidence flags. No retained edge passed BH sensitivity; evidence flags are not paired perturbation ground truth.

Figure 3. Rebuilt tripartite selection and ESV modules. A (upper left), communication-record counts by malignant target and TME source. B (lower left), correlations of unweighted malignant module means with broad-lineage fractions for TNBC (n=8 labels) and ER+ (n=10); none passed BH across six estimable tests. HER2+ (n=4) was not tested. C (right), subtype module membership (19/10/1 genes; 25-gene union). Communication/pathway co-membership is not directed causal evidence.

Figure 4. Rebuilt drug-score evaluation. A, five repeat-specific pooled OOF AUROCs per drug (points) and their mean (diamonds), with ModelID-isolated nested cross-validation. B, matched weighted versus unweighted XGBoost AUROCs across drugs/repeats; points lie on the identity line and probabilities are identical. C, held-out-cell-line pseudobulk AUROCs across two expression assays, not cell-level or independent clinical validation. D, eight highest mean absolute Paclitaxel SHAP contributions across malignant atlas cells, bias excluded; full-fit descriptive explanation only. Conditional confidence intervals for mean-OOF predictions are tabulated separately, not attached to the mean-repeat estimand.

Figure 5. Rebuilt spatial scores in frozen regions. A,B, low/high malignant-signature quartile means joined within each of 15 sections for ESV and the paclitaxel predicted sensitive-class probability. C, section low-minus-high differences. D, descriptive ESV Moran's I from directed row-standardized array six-nearest-neighbor weights; no significance P values. Blue circles denote Cancer and orange triangles Normal (M1/M7/M9/M10). Exact signed-rank tests give ESV P=0.047913, q=0.047913 and paclitaxel-output P=0.002014, q=0.004028 across two endpoints. Sections, not verified independent patients, are the units; regions are not histological boundaries.

Figure 6. MP-inclusive clinical evaluation and exploratory survival. A, ROC curves for mean OOF predictions in 988 I-SPY2 training records. B, five repeat-specific pooled OOF AUROCs, linked by repeat, with mean diamonds. M0=HR/HER2/MP; M1 adds paclitaxel/olaparib rank-based drug outputs; M2 adds clinical ESV/T-cell SL. C, frozen within-I-SPY2 transfer AUROCs in all 100 valid records and 71 durvalumab–olaparib–paclitaxel records; no target recalibration. D, ESV HRs per cohort SD with 95% CIs. METABRIC estimates are time-dependent at 12/60 months. The dagger marks TCGA DSS events/df<10. No overall ESV endpoint passed BH; the isolated 60-month CI is not an overall confirmatory result.
